adultGuidance: Let your child pick a familiar person, place, thing, or event. On each page, ask them to describe it out loud first, then write and draw. The sentence frames fade across the pack, so your child builds toward writing their own describing sentences. Finally, have them show their drawing to someone and tell three things about it.
description: Describe a person, place, thing, or event with details, then draw it to help explain your ideas.
learningFocus: Describe a thing you love out loud, then write two complete describing sentences about it.
